```{r}
library(ADMerge)

BIOCARD_table =get_src_table(path = "/Users/shijia.zhang/Downloads/BIOCARD August 2021 internal",

Biocard_merged$analysis_data


complete_BIOCARD <- review_complete(
  Biocard_merged,
  check_cols = c(
    # -- 基本信息/对齐 --
    "ID_merged",        # 主键（你合并后的一致 ID）
    "Date_timeline",    # 访视日期（或基线日期）
    "VISITNO",          # 访视编号

    # -- 诊断/结局（用于筛 CN 基线 & 推导事件） --
    "DIAGNOSIS",        # 每次访视的临床综合诊断（用来筛 baseline=CN）
    # 若你已有结局衍生列，也可一并检查（没有就删掉下面两行）：

    # -- 人口统计/遗传 --
    "SEX",
    "EDUC",
    "BIRTHYEAR",
    "APOECODE",         # APOE（建议后续衍生 APOE4=1/0）

    # -- 认知（基线） --
    "C1208A",           # DSST（Digit Symbol；论文用之一）
    "C1A109",           # VPA-Immediate（WMS Paired Associates I）

    # -- MRI（基线） --
    "HIPRIGHTV",        # 右海马 ICV 标化体积
    "ECRIGHTT",         # 右内嗅皮层厚度

    # -- CSF（基线） --
    "ptau181",
    "AB42" # p-tau181（Efficient 模型里保留 p-tau）
    # 如果你CSF列名不同(如 PTAU/PTAU_PGML)，把实际列名放这里
  )
)


complete_BIOCARD$complete_df %>% filter(DIAGNOSIS == "NORMAL") %>% distinct(ID_merged)



unique(complete_BIOCARD$complete_df$DIAGNOSIS)



#EDUC #BIRTHYEAR (for age) #C1208A (DSST) #C1A109 (VPA) #APOECODE  #HIPRIGHTV(hippo_right) #ECRIGHTT(entorhinal_R_thick) #AB42 #ptau181
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(survival)
library(timeROC)
library(gtsummary)
```


```{r}
df <- complete_BIOCARD$complete_df

pred_vars <- df %>%
  mutate(
    DSST    = .data$C1208A,       # Digit Symbol
    VPA_IM  = .data$C1A109,       # Paired Associates I
    PTAU    = .data$ptau181,      # CSF p-tau181
    HIPPO_R = .data$HIPRIGHTV,    # 右海马（ICV 标化）
    ERC_R   = .data$ECRIGHTT,     # 右内嗅皮层厚度
    AGE     = lubridate::year(.data$Date_timeline) - .data$BIRTHYEAR,
    AB42 = .data$AB42,

    # —— 关键修改：APOE4 兼容 "3.4 / 34 / E3/E4 / 3-4" 等格式 ——
    APOE4 = case_when(
      is.na(.data$APOECODE) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ as.integer(grepl("4",
                gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(.data$APOECODE))
              ))
    )
  )



baseline <- pred_vars %>%
  filter(.data$DIAGNOSIS == "NORMAL") %>%
  arrange(.data$ID_merged, .data$Date_timeline) %>%
  group_by(.data$ID_merged) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged,
    baseline_date = .data$Date_timeline,
    AGE, EDUC = .data$EDUC, APOE4,AB42,
    DSST, VPA_IM, HIPPO_R, ERC_R, PTAU
  )


## 2) 用"全时间线"生成事件/删失（用 analysis_data，不限于 complete_df）
diag_long <- Biocard_merged$analysis_data %>%     # 确保有 ID/日期/诊断三列
  select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, DIAGNOSIS)


outcome <- diag_long %>%
  inner_join(baseline %>% select(ID_merged, baseline_date), by = "ID_merged") %>%
  filter(.data$Date_timeline >= .data$baseline_date) %>%
  mutate(is_event = .data$DIAGNOSIS %in% c("MCI", "DEMENTIA")) %>%
  group_by(.data$ID_merged) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_date = first(.data$baseline_date),
    event_date = if (any(is_event, na.rm = TRUE)) min(.data$Date_timeline[is_event], na.rm = TRUE) else as.Date(NA),
    last_date  = max(.data$Date_timeline, na.rm = TRUE),
    status = as.integer(!is.na(event_date)),  # 1=事件, 0=删失
    T_event = ifelse(status == 1,
                     as.numeric(difftime(event_date, baseline_date, units = "days"))/365.25,
                     as.numeric(difftime(last_date,  baseline_date, units = "days"))/365.25),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


anal <- baseline %>%
  inner_join(outcome, by = c("ID_merged", "baseline_date")) %>%
  filter(T_event > 0)


# 连续变量列表
num_cols <- c("AGE","EDUC","DSST","VPA_IM","HIPPO_R","ERC_R","PTAU","AB42")

# 备份标准化参数（可复现）
sc_mu <- sapply(anal[num_cols], function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
sc_sd <- sapply(anal[num_cols], function(x) sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE))


anal[num_cols] <- lapply(num_cols, function(v) as.numeric(scale(anal[[v]])))

library(survival)

fit_eff <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE + EDUC + APOE4 +
                   DSST + VPA_IM + HIPPO_R + ERC_R + PTAU + AB42,
                 data = anal)

fit_eff %>% tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE)
```
```{r}
library(survivalROC)
lp <- predict(fit_eff, type = "lp")  # 线性预测分数
for (tt in c(5, 7, 10)) {
  r <- survivalROC(Stime = anal$T_event, status = anal$status,
                   marker = lp, predict.time = tt,
                   method = "NNE", span = 0.25)
  cat(tt, "years AUC =", round(r$AUC, 3), "\n")
}

```
```{r}
# 选模型：含 AB42 的 Full（fit_eff）或不含 AB42 的 Efficient（fit_eff2）
fit <- fit_eff        # <- 如需改用 Efficient：fit <- fit_eff2

library(survivalROC)
library(ggplot2)
# 线性预测分数 = Cox 风险分值（marker）
lp <- predict(fit, type = "lp")

# 计算 5/7/10 年 ROC
times <- c(5, 7, 10)
roclist <- lapply(times, function(tt)
  survivalROC(
    Stime        = anal$T_event,
    status       = anal$status,
    marker       = lp,
    predict.time = tt,
    method       = "NNE",
    span         = 0.25
  )
)

# 拼成绘图数据框（带上 AUC 到图例）
rocdf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(times), function(i) {
  data.frame(
    fpr  = roclist[[i]]$FP,              # 1 - specificity
    tpr  = roclist[[i]]$TP,              # sensitivity
    time = sprintf("%dy (AUC=%.3f)", times[i], roclist[[i]]$AUC)
  )
}))
rocdf <- rocdf[complete.cases(rocdf), ]

# 画图
auc_plot = ggplot(rocdf, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = time)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Time-dependent ROC (Cox risk score)",
    x = "1 - Specificity (FPR)", y = "Sensitivity (TPR)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

# 同时在控制台打印各时点 AUC
for (i in seq_along(times)) {
  cat(times[i], "years AUC =", round(roclist[[i]]$AUC, 3), "\n")
}

auc_plot

```



```{r}
# BIOCARD example point 2

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(survival)

BIOCARD_table =get_src_table(path = "/Users/shijia.zhang/Downloads/BIOCARD August 2021 internal",
              ID_usr_list = c("SUBJECT_ID"),
              DATE_usr_list = c("VISITDATE","DIAGDATE","date","MRIDATE"),
              IS_overlap_list = c("FALSE"),
              WINDOW_list = c(366))


Biocard_merged = ad_merge(path = "/Users/shijia.zhang/Downloads/BIOCARD August 2021 internal",DATE_type = "Date",timeline_file = "BIOCARD_CognitiveData",dict_src = BIOCARD_table)




complete_BIOCARD <- review_complete(
  Biocard_merged,
  check_cols = c(
    # -- 基本信息/对齐 --
    "ID_merged",        # 主键（你合并后的一致 ID）
    "Date_timeline",    # 访视日期（或基线日期）
    "VISITNO",          # 访视编号

    # -- 诊断/结局（用于筛 CN 基线 & 推导事件） --
    "DIAGNOSIS",        # 每次访视的临床综合诊断（用来筛 baseline=CN）

    # -- 人口统计/遗传 --
    "SEX",
    "EDUC",
    "BIRTHYEAR",
    "APOECODE",         # APOE（建议后续衍生 APOE4=1/0）

    # -- 认知（基线） --
    "C1208A",           # DSST（Digit Symbol；论文用之一）
    "C1A109",           # VPA-Immediate（WMS Paired Associates I）

    # -- MRI（基线） --
    "HIPRIGHTV",        # 右海马 ICV 标化体积
    "ECRIGHTT",         # 右内嗅皮层厚度

    # -- CSF（基线） --
    "ptau181",
    "AB42"
  )
)


df <- complete_BIOCARD$complete_df

df1 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    eTIV = coalesce(EstimatedTotalIntraCranialVol, INTRACVOL),
    WMH_icv = WM_hypointensities / eTIV,
    WMH_log = log1p(WMH_icv),
    AGE = year(Date_timeline) - BIRTHYEAR
  ) %>%
  filter(is.na(Missingness) | Missingness == 0)


# 2) 选"基线"：最早一次 DIAGNOSIS==NORMAL，且 WMH 与 CSF 三项都有（ADMerge 已做 ±366d 窗口）
baseline <- df1 %>%
  filter(DIAGNOSIS == "NORMAL",
         !is.na(WMH_log), !is.na(ttau), !is.na(ptau181), !is.na(AB42)) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Date_timeline) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged, baseline_date = Date_timeline,
    SEX, EDUC, AGE,
    WMH_log, ttau, ptau181, AB42
  )


diag_long <- Biocard_merged$analysis_data %>%
  select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, DIAGNOSIS)


outcome <- diag_long %>%
  inner_join(baseline %>% select(ID_merged, baseline_date), by = "ID_merged") %>%
  filter(Date_timeline >= baseline_date) %>%
  mutate(is_event = DIAGNOSIS %in% c("MCI","DEMENTIA")) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_date = first(baseline_date),
    event_date = if (any(is_event, na.rm=TRUE))
      min(Date_timeline[is_event], na.rm=TRUE) else as.Date(NA),
    last_date = max(Date_timeline, na.rm=TRUE),
    status = as.integer(!is.na(event_date)),
    T_event = ifelse(status==1,
      as.numeric(difftime(event_date, baseline_date, units="days"))/365.25,
      as.numeric(difftime(last_date,  baseline_date, units="days"))/365.25),
    .groups="drop"
  )


anal <- baseline %>%
  inner_join(outcome, by=c("ID_merged","baseline_date")) %>%
  filter(T_event > 0)

# 连续变量 z 分数（论文口径）
zcols <- c("AGE","EDUC","WMH_log","ttau","ptau181","AB42")
for (v in zcols) anal[[paste0(v,"_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(anal[[v]]))

# 1) 交互模型
fit_int <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z +
                   WMH_log_z*ttau_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z,
                 data = anal)
summary(fit_int)



# 2) simple slopes：在低/高 t-tau 评估 WMH 效应（用 tertiles 更贴论文）
tt_cut <- quantile(anal$ttau, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)
anal <- anal %>%
  mutate(
    ttau_grp = cut(ttau, breaks = c(-Inf, tt_cut, Inf),
                   labels = c("Low","Mid","High"), include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

# 只用 Low / High 两组分别看 WMH 的 HR
fit_low  <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z +
                    WMH_log_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z,
                  data = subset(anal, ttau_grp=="Low"))
fit_high <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z +
                    WMH_log_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z,
                  data = subset(anal, ttau_grp=="High"))

exp(cbind(HR_low  = coef(fit_low )["WMH_log_z"],
          HR_high = coef(fit_high)["WMH_log_z"]))
confint(fit_low )["WMH_log_z",]
confint(fit_high)["WMH_log_z",]
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)


anal <- anal %>%
  mutate(
    SEX = factor(SEX, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("M", "F"))
  )

# 构造不同 t-tau 下的预测数据
wmh_seq <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 100)
make_pred <- function(ttau_level) {
  data.frame(
    AGE_z = 0,
    SEX = factor("F", levels = levels(anal$SEX)),
    EDUC_z = 0,
    WMH_log_z = wmh_seq,
    ttau_z = rep(ttau_level, length(wmh_seq)),
    ptau181_z = 0,
    AB42_z = 0,
    tgroup = ifelse(ttau_level < 0, "Low t-tau", "High t-tau")
  )
}

pred_low  <- make_pred(-1)
pred_high <- make_pred(1)
pred_plot <- rbind(pred_low, pred_high)
pred_plot$risk <- predict(fit_int, newdata = pred_plot, type = "lp")



p_int <- ggplot(pred_plot, aes(x = WMH_log_z, y = risk, color = tgroup)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "WMH * t-tau Interaction (Soldan et al.)",
    x = "WMH (z-score)",
    y = "Log Relative Risk"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("High t-tau" = "#EF476F", "Low t-tau" = "#06D6A0"))

print(p_int)


# 提取主效应HR及置信区间
HR_low  <- exp(coef(fit_low)["WMH_log_z"])
HR_high <- exp(coef(fit_high)["WMH_log_z"])
CI_low  <- exp(confint(fit_low)["WMH_log_z",])
CI_high <- exp(confint(fit_high)["WMH_log_z",])

forest_dat <- data.frame(
  Group = c("Low t-tau", "High t-tau"),
  HR = c(HR_low, HR_high),
  LCL = c(CI_low[1], CI_high[1]),
  UCL = c(CI_low[2], CI_high[2])
)

p_forest <- ggplot(forest_dat, aes(x = Group, y = HR, ymin = LCL, ymax = UCL)) +
  geom_pointrange(size = 1.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Hazard Ratio of WMH by t-tau Group",
       y = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)", x = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

print(p_forest)


library(patchwork)
final_plot <- auc_plot + p_int + plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Replication of Multi-modal Prognostic Models in BIOCARD",
    subtitle = "Left: Time-dependent AUC (Albert et al.). Right: WMH x t-tau Interaction (Soldan et al.)",
    caption = "Data processed and merged via ADMerge R package."
  )
print(final_plot)
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)

# 1) 构建 MRI 纵向：按"各自第一次 MRI"定零点，年为单位
mri_long <- df1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(WMH_log)) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  mutate(t0_mri = min(Date_timeline, na.rm = TRUE),
         t_years = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, t0_mri, units="days"))/365.25,
         AGE0 = first(year(t0_mri) - BIRTHYEAR),
         SEX0 = first(SEX)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2) CSF 纵向：同样按"各自第一次 CSF"定零点（或同 MRI 零点，一致性更强）
csf_long <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(ttau)) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  mutate(t0_csf = min(Date_timeline, na.rm = TRUE),
         t_years = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, t0_csf, units="days"))/365.25,
         AGE0 = first(year(t0_csf) - BIRTHYEAR),
         SEX0 = first(SEX)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3) 各自随机斜率（≥2 次观测的被试才有斜率）
mri_long2 <- mri_long %>% group_by(ID_merged) %>% filter(n() >= 2) %>% ungroup()
csf_long2 <- csf_long %>% group_by(ID_merged) %>% filter(n() >= 2) %>% ungroup()

fit_wmh_lmm  <- lmer(WMH_log ~ t_years + AGE0 + SEX0 + (t_years | ID_merged), data = mri_long2)
fit_ttau_lmm <- lmer(scale(ttau) ~ t_years + AGE0 + SEX0 + (t_years | ID_merged), data = csf_long2)

sl_wmh  <- ranef(fit_wmh_lmm)$ID_merged[,"t_years", drop=TRUE]
sl_ttau <- ranef(fit_ttau_lmm)$ID_merged[,"t_years", drop=TRUE]

slopes <- tibble(
  ID_merged = rownames(ranef(fit_wmh_lmm)$ID_merged),
  slope_WMH = as.numeric(sl_wmh)
) %>%
  inner_join(tibble(
    ID_merged = rownames(ranef(fit_ttau_lmm)$ID_merged),
    slope_ttau = as.numeric(sl_ttau)
  ), by = "ID_merged")

# 4) 相关 + 回归（可加稳健法/去极端值）
cor.test(slopes$slope_WMH, slopes$slope_ttau)
summary(lm(slope_WMH ~ slope_ttau, data = slopes))
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    WMH_bin  = ifelse(WMH_log >= wmh_q, "High WMH","Low WMH"),
    ttau_hi  = ifelse(ttau >= tt_cut[2], "High t-tau","Low t-tau"),
    group_2x2 = paste0(WMH_bin," / ", ttau_hi)
  )

ggsurvplot(sf, conf.int = FALSE, risk.table = TRUE,
```

```{r}
# FIX: 冒号改为 <-
fit_int <- coxph(Surv(T_event,status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z +
               WMH_log_z*ttau_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z, data=anal)

b <- coef(fit_int)
V <- vcov(fit_int)

beta_W  <- b["WMH_log_z"]
beta_I  <- b["WMH_log_z:ttau_z"]

var_W   <- V["WMH_log_z","WMH_log_z"]
var_I   <- V["WMH_log_z:ttau_z","WMH_log_z:ttau_z"]
cov_WI  <- V["WMH_log_z","WMH_log_z:ttau_z"]

simple_slope <- function(t0) {
  est <- beta_W + t0*beta_I                    # log(HR) of WMH at ttau_z = t0
  se  <- sqrt(var_W + t0^2*var_I + 2*t0*cov_WI)
  HR  <- exp(est); LCL <- exp(est - 1.96*se); UCL <- exp(est + 1.96*se)
  p   <- 2*pnorm(-abs(est/se))
  data.frame(ttau_z=t0, HR=HR, LCL=LCL, UCL=UCL, p=p)
}

# 看几个代表性水平：均值±1SD、以及 t-tau 的三分位数中心
tt_vals <- c(-1, 0, 1,
             scale(quantile(anal$ttau, probs=c(1/3,2/3), na.rm=TRUE))[,1])
do.call(rbind, lapply(tt_vals, simple_slope))
```

```{r}
    SEX, EDUC, AGE, WMH_log, ttau, ptau181, AB42
  )

diag_long <- Biocard_merged$analysis_data %>%
  select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, DIAGNOSIS)

outcome <- diag_long %>%
  inner_join(baseline %>% select(ID_merged, baseline_date), by = "ID_merged") %>%
  filter(Date_timeline >= baseline_date) %>%
  mutate(is_event = DIAGNOSIS %in% c("MCI", "DEMENTIA")) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_date = first(baseline_date),
    event_date = if (any(is_event, na.rm=TRUE)) min(Date_timeline[is_event], na.rm=TRUE) else as.Date(NA),
    last_date = max(Date_timeline, na.rm=TRUE),
    status = as.integer(!is.na(event_date)),
    T_event = ifelse(status==1,
      as.numeric(difftime(event_date, baseline_date, units="days"))/365.25,
      as.numeric(difftime(last_date,  baseline_date, units="days"))/365.25),
    .groups="drop"
  )

anal <- baseline %>%
  inner_join(outcome, by = c("ID_merged", "baseline_date")) %>%
  filter(T_event > 0)

```


```{r}
# 连续变量标准化
zcols <- c("AGE","EDUC","WMH_log","ttau","ptau181","AB42")
for (v in zcols) anal[[paste0(v,"_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(anal[[v]]))

# Cox全模型
fit_eff <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z + WMH_log_z + ttau_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z, data = anal)

# 计算预测分数
lp <- predict(fit_eff, type = "lp")
times <- c(5, 7, 10)
roclist <- lapply(times, function(tt)
  survivalROC(
    Stime = anal$T_event,
    status = anal$status,
    marker = lp,
    predict.time = tt,
    method = "NNE",
    span = 0.25
  )
)
rocdf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(times), function(i) {
  data.frame(
    fpr  = roclist[[i]]$FP,
    tpr  = roclist[[i]]$TP,
    time = sprintf("%dy (AUC=%.3f)", times[i], roclist[[i]]$AUC)
  )
}))
rocdf <- rocdf[complete.cases(rocdf), ]

p_auc <- ggplot(rocdf, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = time)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "A) Time-dependent ROC (Albert et al.)",
    x = "1 - Specificity (FPR)", y = "Sensitivity (TPR)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

```

```{r}
# 交互模型
fit_int <- coxph(Surv(T_event, status) ~ AGE_z + SEX + EDUC_z + WMH_log_z*ttau_z + ptau181_z + AB42_z, data = anal)

# 加载包
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)

# 强制把 SEX 变为因子
anal <- anal %>%
  mutate(SEX = factor(SEX))

# t-tau 分三组
tt_cut <- quantile(anal$ttau, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)
anal <- anal %>%
  mutate(
    ttau_grp = cut(
      ttau,
      breaks = c(-Inf, tt_cut, Inf),
      labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )

# 画交互作图数据
wmh_seq <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 100)
make_pred <- function(ttau_level) {
  data.frame(
    AGE_z = 0,
    SEX = factor("2", levels = c("1", "2")),
    EDUC_z = 0,
    WMH_log_z = wmh_seq,
    ttau_z = rep(ttau_level, length(wmh_seq)),
    ptau181_z = 0,
    AB42_z = 0
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      risk = predict(fit_int, newdata = ., type = "lp"),
      ttau_level = factor(ttau_level)
    )
}
# 用 t-tau z-score -1, +1 作为 low/high
pred_low <- make_pred(-1)
pred_high <- make_pred(1)

pred_plot <- bind_rows(
  transform(pred_low, tgroup = "Low t-tau"),
  transform(pred_high, tgroup = "High t-tau")
)

# 作图
p_int <- ggplot(pred_plot, aes(x = WMH_log_z, y = risk, color = tgroup)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(
    title = "WMH x t-tau Interaction (Soldan et al.)",
    x = "WMH (z-score)",
    y = "Log Relative Risk"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())




```


```{r}
library(patchwork)
final_plot <- p_auc + p_int + plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Replication of Multi-modal Prognostic Models in BIOCARD",
    subtitle = "Left: Time-dependent AUC (Albert et al.). Right: WMH x t-tau Interaction (Soldan et al.)",
    caption = "Data processed and merged via ADMerge R package."
  )
print(final_plot)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(lmerTest)

complete_ADNI_csf <- review_complete(
  adni_merged_csf,
  check_cols = c("ID_merged","Date_timeline",
                 # CSF
                 "AB42_F","pT217_F",
                 # 协变量
                 "PTDOBYY","PTGENDER","PTEDUCAT","GENOTYPE","DIAGNOSIS")
)

bl_csf <- complete_ADNI_csf$complete_df %>%
  mutate(Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline)) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Date_timeline) %>%
  distinct(ID_merged, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged,
    bl_date    = Date_timeline,
    Abeta42_bl = AB42_F,
    pTau_bl    = pT217_F,
    Sex_bl     = PTGENDER,
    Edu_bl     = PTEDUCAT,
    APOE4_bl   = GENOTYPE,
    PTDOBYY_bl = PTDOBYY,
    Dx_bl_raw  = DIAGNOSIS
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex_bl = factor(case_when(Sex_bl == 1 ~ "M",
                              Sex_bl == 2 ~ "F",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("M","F")),
    Dx_bl  = factor(case_when(Dx_bl_raw == 1 ~ "CN",
                              Dx_bl_raw == 2 ~ "MCI",
                              Dx_bl_raw == 3 ~ "AD",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("CN","MCI","AD")),
    APOE4_carrier = if_else(str_detect(APOE4_bl, "4"), 1L, 0L),
    Age_bl  = year(bl_date) - PTDOBYY_bl,

    pTau_bl_log   = ifelse(pTau_bl > 0, log(pTau_bl), NA_real_),
    Abeta42_bl_log= ifelse(Abeta42_bl > 0, log(Abeta42_bl), NA_real_),

    Abeta42_bl_c  = as.numeric(scale(Abeta42_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    pTau_bl_log_c = as.numeric(scale(pTau_bl_log,  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Age_bl_c      = as.numeric(scale(Age_bl,       center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  select(ID_merged, bl_date,
         Abeta42_bl, Abeta42_bl_log, Abeta42_bl_c,
         pTau_bl, pTau_bl_log, pTau_bl_log_c,
         Age_bl_c, Sex_bl, Edu_bl, APOE4_carrier, Dx_bl)

csf_long <- bl_csf %>%
  left_join(
    adni_merged_csf$analysis_data %>%
      transmute(ID_merged,
                Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline),
                AB42_F, pT217_F),
    by = "ID_merged"
  ) %>%
  filter(Date_timeline >= bl_date) %>%
  mutate(
    Time_year  = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, bl_date, units = "days"))/365.25,
    pTau_log   = ifelse(pT217_F > 0,  log(pT217_F),  NA_real_),
    Abeta_log  = ifelse(AB42_F  > 0,  log(AB42_F),   NA_real_)
  )

dat_ptau <- csf_long %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  filter(sum(!is.na(pT217_F)) >= 2, any(Time_year > 0 & !is.na(pT217_F))) %>%
  ungroup()

m_pTau_from_Abeta <- lmer(
  pTau_log ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c  + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    Age_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = dat_ptau
)
summary(m_pTau_from_Abeta)

dat_abeta <- csf_long %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  filter(sum(!is.na(AB42_F)) >= 2, any(Time_year > 0 & !is.na(AB42_F))) %>%
  ungroup()

m_Abeta_from_pTau <- lmer(
  Abeta_log ~ Time_year +
    pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    Age_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = dat_abeta
)
summary(m_Abeta_from_pTau)
```

```{r}
complete_ADNI_cog <- review_complete(

bl_cog <- complete_ADNI_cog$complete_df %>%

  transmute(
    ID_merged,
    bl_date    = Date_timeline,
    Hipp_bl    = (ST29SV + ST88SV)/2,
    EC_bl      = (ST24TA + ST83TA)/2,
    ICV_bl     = ST10CV,
    pTau_bl    = pT217_F,
    Abeta42_bl = AB42_F,
    Sex_bl     = PTGENDER,
    Edu_bl     = PTEDUCAT,
    APOE4_bl   = GENOTYPE,
    Dx_bl_raw  = DIAGNOSIS,
    PTDOBYY_bl = PTDOBYY
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex_bl = factor(case_when(Sex_bl == 1 ~ "M",
                              Sex_bl == 2 ~ "F",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_),
                    levels = c("M","F")),
    Dx_bl  = factor(case_when(Dx_bl_raw == 1 ~ "CN",
                              Dx_bl_raw == 2 ~ "MCI",
                              Dx_bl_raw == 3 ~ "AD",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_),
                    levels = c("CN","MCI","AD")),
    APOE4_carrier = if_else(str_detect(APOE4_bl, "4"), 1L, 0L),

    Age_bl   = year(bl_date) - PTDOBYY_bl,

    pTau_bl_log   = ifelse(pTau_bl > 0, log(pTau_bl), NA_real_),
    Abeta42_bl_c  = as.numeric(scale(Abeta42_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    pTau_bl_log_c = as.numeric(scale(pTau_bl_log,  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Hipp_bl_c     = as.numeric(scale(Hipp_bl,      center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    EC_bl_c       = as.numeric(scale(EC_bl,        center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    ICV_bl_c      = as.numeric(scale(ICV_bl,       center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Age_bl_c      = as.numeric(scale(Age_bl,       center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  select(
    ID_merged, bl_date,
    Hipp_bl_c, EC_bl_c, ICV_bl_c,
    pTau_bl_log_c, Abeta42_bl_c,
    Age_bl_c, Sex_bl, Edu_bl, APOE4_carrier, Dx_bl
  )

dat_adas <- bl_cog %>%
  left_join(
    adni_merged_adas$analysis_data %>%
      select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, TOTSCORE),
    by = "ID_merged"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline),
    Time_year = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, bl_date, units = "days"))/365.25
  ) %>%
  filter(Date_timeline >= bl_date) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  filter(
    sum(!is.na(TOTSCORE)) >= 2,
    any(Time_year > 0 & !is.na(TOTSCORE))
  ) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Time_year) %>%
  ungroup()

stopifnot(all(c("Hipp_bl_c","EC_bl_c","pTau_bl_log_c",
                "Abeta42_bl_c","ICV_bl_c","Age_bl_c",
                "Sex_bl","Edu_bl","APOE4_carrier","Dx_bl") %in% names(dat_adas)))


m5_adas_full <- lmer(
  TOTSCORE ~ Time_year +
    Hipp_bl_c        + Time_year:Hipp_bl_c +
    EC_bl_c          + Time_year:EC_bl_c +
    pTau_bl_log_c    + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    Abeta42_bl_c     + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    ICV_bl_c +
    Age_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +

)

    ICV_bl_c +
    Age_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = dat_adas
)

m5_adas_ec <- lmer(

)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(stringr)
  library(lmerTest)
})

adni_merged_mri <- ad_merge(
  path = "ADNI_demonstration",
  DATE_type = "Date",
  timeline_file = "UCSFFSX7",
  dict_src = ADNI_table
)

check_cols <- c(
  "AB42_F","pT217_F",
  "TOTSCORE","LIMMTOTAL",
  "PTDOBYY","PTGENDER","PTEDUCAT","GENOTYPE","DIAGNOSIS")


complete_ADNI_mri <- review_complete(adni_merged_mri, check_cols = check_cols)

bl_all <- complete_ADNI_mri$complete_df %>%
  mutate(
    ID_merged     = as.character(ID_merged),
    Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline)
  ) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(check_cols), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Date_timeline) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    ID_merged,
    mri_bl_date = Date_timeline,

    Hipp_bl   = (ST29SV + ST88SV)/2,
    EC_bl     = (ST24TA + ST83TA)/2,
    ICV_bl    = ST10CV,
    Hipp_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(Hipp_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    EC_bl_c   = as.numeric(scale(EC_bl,   center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),

    ADAS_bl   = TOTSCORE,
    LM_bl     = LIMMTOTAL,
    ADAS_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(TOTSCORE,  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    LM_bl_c   = as.numeric(scale(LIMMTOTAL, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),

    Abeta42_bl    = AB42_F,
    pTau_bl       = pT217_F,
    Abeta42_bl_c  = as.numeric(scale(Abeta42_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    pTau_bl_log_c = {
      x <- ifelse(pTau_bl > 0, log(pTau_bl), NA_real_)
      as.numeric(scale(x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
    },

    PTDOBYY_bl  = PTDOBYY,
    PTGENDER_bl = PTGENDER,
    PTEDUCAT_bl = PTEDUCAT,
    GENOTYPE_bl = GENOTYPE,
    DIAGNOSIS_bl= DIAGNOSIS,
    Age_mri_bl   = year(mri_bl_date) - PTDOBYY,
    Age_mri_bl_c = as.numeric(scale(Age_mri_bl, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Sex_bl = factor(case_when(PTGENDER == 1 ~ "M",
                              PTGENDER == 2 ~ "F",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("M","F")),
    Dx_bl  = factor(case_when(DIAGNOSIS == 1 ~ "CN",
                              DIAGNOSIS == 2 ~ "MCI",
                              DIAGNOSIS == 3 ~ "AD",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("CN","MCI","AD")),
    Edu_bl        = PTEDUCAT,
    APOE4_carrier = as.integer(str_detect(as.character(GENOTYPE), "4"))
  )

mri_long <- adni_merged_mri$analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    ID_merged     = as.character(ID_merged),
    Date_timeline = as.Date(Date_timeline)
  ) %>%
  semi_join(bl_all %>% select(ID_merged), by = "ID_merged") %>%
  select(ID_merged, Date_timeline, ST29SV, ST88SV, ST24TA, ST83TA, ST10CV) %>%
  distinct(ID_merged, Date_timeline, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(bl_all, by = "ID_merged") %>%
  filter(Date_timeline >= mri_bl_date) %>%
  mutate(
    Time_year = as.numeric(difftime(Date_timeline, mri_bl_date, units = "days"))/365.25,
    Hipp      = (ST29SV + ST88SV)/2,
    ECthick   = (ST24TA + ST83TA)/2,
    ICV       = ST10CV,
    ICV_c     = as.numeric(scale(ICV,     center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    Hipp_z    = as.numeric(scale(Hipp,    center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    ECthick_z = as.numeric(scale(ECthick, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID_merged) %>%
  filter(sum(!is.na(Hipp)) >= 2 | sum(!is.na(ECthick)) >= 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(ID_merged, Time_year)

m_Hipp <- lmer(
  Hipp_z ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c  + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    ADAS_bl_c     + Time_year:ADAS_bl_c +
    LM_bl_c       + Time_year:LM_bl_c +
    Age_mri_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    ICV_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = mri_long %>% filter(!is.na(Hipp_z))
)
summary(m_Hipp)

m_EC <- lmer(
  ECthick_z ~ Time_year +
    Abeta42_bl_c  + Time_year:Abeta42_bl_c +
    pTau_bl_log_c + Time_year:pTau_bl_log_c +
    ADAS_bl_c     + Time_year:ADAS_bl_c +
    LM_bl_c       + Time_year:LM_bl_c +
    Age_mri_bl_c + Sex_bl + Edu_bl + factor(APOE4_carrier) + Dx_bl +
    ICV_c +
    (1 + Time_year | ID_merged),
  data = mri_long %>% filter(!is.na(ECthick_z))
)
summary(m_EC)
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Longitudinal Alignment Figures (A/B/C/D)
# ===============================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# ---------- Helpers ----------
midpoints <- function(t) {
  tn <- if (inherits(t, "Date")) as.numeric(t) else t
  mids_num <- (tn[-1] + tn[-length(tn)]) / 2
  if (inherits(t, "Date")) as.Date(mids_num, origin = "1970-01-01") else mids_num
}

build_windows <- function(t, R, mode = c("no_overlap","overlap")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  is_date <- inherits(t, "Date")
  tn <- if (is_date) as.numeric(t) else t
  tn <- sort(tn)
  Ci_left  <- tn - R
  Ci_right <- tn + R

  if (mode == "overlap") {
    out <- data.frame(anchor = tn, left = Ci_left, right = Ci_right, type = "C_i")
  } else {
    mids_num  <- (tn[-1] + tn[-length(tn)]) / 2
    Vi_left   <- c(-Inf, mids_num)
    Vi_right  <- c(mids_num,  Inf)
    out <- data.frame(
      anchor = tn,
      left   = pmax(Ci_left,  Vi_left),
      right  = pmin(Ci_right, Vi_right),
      type   = "W_i = V_i cap C_i"
    )
  }
  if (is_date) {
    out$anchor <- as.Date(out$anchor, origin = "1970-01-01")
    out$left   <- as.Date(out$left,   origin = "1970-01-01")
    out$right  <- as.Date(out$right,  origin = "1970-01-01")
  }
  out
}

assign_reference <- function(obs, anchors, R, mode = c("no_overlap","overlap")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  is_date <- inherits(anchors, "Date")
  to_num  <- function(x) if (is_date) as.numeric(x) else x
  a_num <- to_num(anchors)
  o_num <- to_num(obs$time)

  if (mode == "no_overlap") {
    W <- build_windows(anchors, R, mode = "no_overlap")
    L <- to_num(W$left); Rr <- to_num(W$right)
    can <- sapply(seq_along(a_num), function(i) o_num >= L[i] & o_num < Rr[i])
  } else {
    can <- sapply(a_num, function(ai) abs(o_num - ai) <= R)
  }
  if (is.vector(can)) can <- matrix(can, ncol = 1)

  assigned_idx <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(obs))
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(obs))) {
    cand <- which(can[k, ])
    if (length(cand) == 0) next
    d <- abs(o_num[k] - a_num[cand])
    best <- cand[order(d, a_num[cand], decreasing = c(FALSE, TRUE))][1]
    assigned_idx[k] <- best
  }
  obs$assigned_id <- factor(
    ifelse(is.na(assigned_idx), NA_character_, paste0("t", assigned_idx)),
    levels = paste0("t", seq_along(anchors))
  )
  obs
}

add_final_star <- function(obs, anchors) {
  if (!"assigned_id" %in% names(obs)) return(obs %>% mutate(is_final = FALSE))
  is_date <- inherits(anchors, "Date")
  to_num  <- function(x) if (is_date) as.numeric(x) else x
  lookup <- tibble(
    assigned_id = factor(paste0("t", seq_along(anchors)), levels = paste0("t", seq_along(anchors))),
    anchor_num  = to_num(anchors)
  )
  out <- obs %>%
    mutate(time_num = to_num(time)) %>%
    left_join(lookup, by = "assigned_id") %>%
    mutate(dist = ifelse(is.na(assigned_id), NA_real_, abs(time_num - anchor_num))) %>%
    group_by(assigned_id) %>%
    arrange(dist, time_num, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(is_final = ifelse(row_number() == 1 & !is.na(assigned_id), TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-time_num, -anchor_num, -dist)
  out
}

# ---------- plot_timeline ----------
plot_timeline <- function(windows, obs, anchors, title,
                          show_vi = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE,
                          label_mode = c("all","assigned_only","none")) {
  label_mode <- match.arg(label_mode)
  df_win <- windows %>% mutate(anchor_id = paste0("t", seq_len(nrow(windows))))
  is_date <- inherits(df_win$anchor, "Date")
  to_num  <- function(x) if (is_date) as.numeric(x) else x
  from_num<- function(x) if (is_date) as.Date(x, origin = "1970-01-01") else x
  nA <- nrow(df_win)
  # FIX: seq_len(nA) 代替 seq_len(n())
  pal <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(nA), paste0("t", seq_len(nA)))
  all_x_num <- c(to_num(df_win$left), to_num(df_win$right), to_num(obs$time))
  span <- max(all_x_num) - min(all_x_num)
  x_min <- from_num(min(all_x_num) - 0.05 * span)
  x_max <- from_num(max(all_x_num) + 0.05 * span)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = df_win,
              aes(xmin = left, xmax = right, ymin = -0.4, ymax = 0.4, fill = anchor_id),
              alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
    geom_segment(data = df_win,
                 aes(x = anchor, xend = anchor, y = -0.6, yend = 0.6, color = anchor_id),
                 linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_text(data = df_win,
              aes(x = anchor, y = 0.75, label = anchor_id, color = anchor_id),
              size = 6.5, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = time, y = 0, color = assigned_id),
               size = 2.6, alpha = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = time, y = 0),
               size = 2.6, alpha = 0.15, color = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(obs, is_final),
               aes(x = time, y = 0, color = assigned_id, shape = "Final join"),
               size = 4.0, stroke = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Final join" = 8), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1), breaks = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal, drop = FALSE, na.value = "black") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "top" else "none",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, x_max))

  if (label_mode != "none") {
    to_plot <- obs
    if (label_mode == "assigned_only") {
      to_plot <- dplyr::filter(obs, !is.na(assigned_id))
    }
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = to_plot, aes(x = time, y = -0.18, label = label),
      size = 4.5, vjust = 1.2
    )
  }
  if (show_vi) {
    mids <- midpoints(df_win$anchor)
    if (length(mids) > 0) {
      p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = mids, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray55", linewidth = 0.9)
    }
  }
  p
}

# ---------- Timelines ----------
t0 <- as.Date("2021-01-01")
anchors1 <- t0 + c(0, 70, 160)
anchors_biggap <- t0 + c(0, 220, 460)
R1 <- 20
R2 <- 45

# ---------- Observations ----------
obs_A <- bind_rows(
  tibble(time = anchors1[1] + c(-8, +10),   label = c("-8d", "+10d")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[2] + c(+4),        label = c("+4d")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[3] + c(-9, +12),   label = c("-9d", "+12d")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[1] + c(30, 44),    label = c("", "")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[2] + c(30, 50),    label = c("", "")),
  tibble(time = t0 + c(-60, 100),           label = c("", ""))
) %>%
  assign_reference(anchors = anchors1, R = R1, mode = "overlap") %>%
  add_final_star(anchors = anchors1)

obs_B <- bind_rows(
  tibble(time = anchors1[1] + c(-15, +18),      label = c("-15d", "+18d")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[1] + c(+36),           label = c("+36d")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[2] + c(-18, +18, +32), label = c("-18d", "+18d", "+32d")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[3] + c(-22, -8, +8),   label = c("-22d", "-8d", "+8d"))
) %>%
  assign_reference(anchors = anchors1, R = R2, mode = "no_overlap") %>%
  add_final_star(anchors = anchors1)

set.seed(1)
obs_C <- bind_rows(
  tibble(time = anchors_biggap[1] + c(-20, +15, +35), label = c("-20d","+15d","+35d")),
  tibble(time = anchors_biggap[2] + c(+5),            label = c("+5d")),
  tibble(time = anchors_biggap[3] + c(-30, +25),      label = c("-30d","+25d")),
  tibble(time = anchors_biggap[1] + c(120),           label = c("")),
  tibble(time = anchors_biggap[2] + c(160),           label = c(""))
) %>%
  assign_reference(anchors = anchors_biggap, R = R2, mode = "no_overlap") %>%
  add_final_star(anchors = anchors_biggap)

obs_D <- bind_rows(
  tibble(time = anchors1[1] + c(28),             label = c("ov->t1")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[1] + c(44),             label = c("ov->t2")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[2] + c(+22),            label = c("+22d")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[3] + c(-22, +18),       label = c("-22d","+18d")),
  tibble(time = anchors1[1] + c(-12, +12),       label = c("-12d","+12d"))
) %>%
  assign_reference(anchors = anchors1, R = R2, mode = "overlap") %>%
  add_final_star(anchors = anchors1)

# ---------- Windows ----------
win_A        <- build_windows(anchors1,       R = R1, mode = "overlap")
win_B_no_ol  <- build_windows(anchors1,       R = R2, mode = "no_overlap")
win_C_big_no <- build_windows(anchors_biggap, R = R2, mode = "no_overlap")
win_D_ol     <- build_windows(anchors1,       R = R2, mode = "overlap")

# ---------- Panels ----------
pA <- plot_timeline(win_A, obs_A, anchors1,
  title = "A. Nearby alignment (black = unassigned)",
  show_vi = FALSE, show_legend = TRUE, label_mode = "assigned_only"
) + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", labels = label_date("%b %Y"))

pB <- plot_timeline(win_B_no_ol, obs_B, anchors1,
  title = "B. Non-overlap: Voronoi intersect symmetric",
  show_vi = TRUE, show_legend = FALSE, label_mode = "all"
) + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", labels = label_date("%b %Y"))

pC <- plot_timeline(win_C_big_no, obs_C, anchors_biggap,
  title = "C. Non-overlap with large gaps (> WINDOW): Wi = Ci",
  show_vi = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE, label_mode = "none"
) + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 month", labels = label_date("%b %Y"))

pD <- plot_timeline(win_D_ol, obs_D, anchors1,
  title = "D. Overlap: symmetric only (Ci)",
  show_vi = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE, label_mode = "all"
) + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", labels = label_date("%b %Y"))

# ---------- Combine & Save ----------
combined <- pA / pB / pC / pD
combined

ggsave("fig_alignment_combined_ABCD_largefont.png", combined, width = 9, height = 14, dpi = 300)
```
